contributors: Gottfried Schmidtke with ChatGPT and Grok
title: Neutral building definition from incomplete design evidence
intent: Convert incomplete human design evidence into a software-neutral, reconstructable building definition before choosing Revit, Archicad, Rhino, IFC, Blender, or another target platform.
use_when: a sketch, image, PDF or written description defines a building or building object incompletely
the user wants geometry and data that can later be rebuilt in any software
the target authoring platform has not yet been selected
the source contains a mixture of explicit dimensions, visible topology, proportional hints and unresolved marks
not_for: surveyed geometry where the survey itself is already the authoritative digital source
fully specified construction documents that already define all required geometry and reference faces
tasks where the user explicitly wants immediate host-native production only
problem_observed: A general AI tends to collapse building requests into geometry-only outputs such as STL, or silently invent missing dimensions when reconstructing from sketches. That loses BIM semantics, relationships, evidence provenance and unresolved uncertainty.

building_001_case.source: hand sketch with plan and perspective
important_corrections_from_v0_1_to_v0_2: Do not name sketch axes as compass directions without a north arrow.
Treat the right-side 14.0 m as dimensioned, not inferred.
Derive x = 8000 and the 8 m projecting depth arithmetically from binding dimensions.
Quarantine visually estimated 4500 mm and 3000 mm partition dimensions as proportional hints; do not build from them.
Record openings by visible host/topology without inventing counts, widths, heights or exact positions.
Preserve unresolved sketch marks instead of forcing semantic interpretations.
Interpret the roof only to the topology supported by the perspective; leave pitch, heights and overhang depth unresolved.

source_kinds.dimensioned: A figure written on the source. Binding.
source_kinds.derived: Arithmetic from binding dimensions or geometry. Binding only to the extent the derivation does not add an unsupported assumption.
source_kinds.observed: Presence, host, topology or relation is visible; measure is not binding.
source_kinds.proportional: Visual estimate only. Non-binding. Do not build from it.
source_kinds.convention: Chosen to establish a local reference frame, such as local origin/elevation zero; not surveyed.

source_evidence_model.rule: Evidence status and confidence are independent. Confidence does not promote an observed or proportional value into binding geometry.

new_lesson.statement: Evidence truth and reconstruction/buildability are independent axes.
new_lesson.reason: A geometric boundary may be dimensioned or derived yet still have unresolved solidity, opening conditions, wall thickness or semantic representation.

example.object: shared boundary between the right bedroom and living area
example.known: boundary lies on y = 6000 over the 6 m projecting wing width
example.unknown: whether it is a continuous solid partition or interrupted by a corner opening

reference_method: Establish a local source coordinate frame without inventing compass orientation.
Classify each source statement or mark by evidence kind before turning it into model geometry.
Extract binding dimensions exactly as written.
Derive only arithmetic consequences that add no unsupported design assumption.
Create authoritative points, edges, polygons and levels from binding evidence.
Record semantic objects and topology separately from their geometric completeness.
Record relationships such as contains, bounds, hosts, connects, separates and supports.
Assign a reconstruction/build state independently from source evidence status.
Preserve unknown values as null; never silently invent them to complete the model.
Store proportional readings separately as non-binding hints.
Generate validation invariants that another AI/software implementation must satisfy.
Only after the neutral model is stable, choose a target adapter such as Revit, Archicad, Rhino, IFC or Blender.

semantics: building-element type when supported by evidence

proposed_neutral_workflow: Neutral JSON plus optional Markdown companion

relationship_to_current_arpl.current_state: ARPL currently descends from professional production logic toward Revit/API execution.
relationship_to_current_arpl.gap: The repository does not yet define an upstream software-neutral workflow that converts incomplete source evidence into a reconstructable building specification before platform selection.
relationship_to_current_arpl.proposal: Add a software-neutral upstream work class and knowledge branch rather than forcing this workflow into existing W4 Revit building authoring.
relationship_to_current_arpl.downstream_handoff: Neutral Building Specification -> target resolver/adapter -> W4 host-specific building authoring -> typed operation -> execution -> QA/QC

iterations.instruction: Translate the sketch directly into a neutral JSON building specification.
iterations.result: Correct main L-shaped footprint and room program, but introduced unsupported compass directions and guessed partition coordinates; roof interpretation was too specific.
iterations.problem: The first pass mixed authoritative evidence with proportional inference and silently elevated some guesses into buildable geometry.
iterations.found_by: independent review by Grok against the source sketch

iterations.instruction: Re-check every datum against the sketch and distinguish dimensioned, derived, observed, proportional, convention and unknown evidence.
iterations.result: Binding geometry, observed topology, proportional hints, unknowns and validation policies were separated; unsupported compass and partition assumptions were withdrawn.
iterations.problem: The remaining build rule still couples source_kind to buildability too tightly.
iterations.found_by: review of derived shared boundary whose location is known but solidity/opening state remains unresolved

iterations.instruction: Separate evidence status from reconstruction status using an independent build_state.
iterations.result: Allows exact topology to coexist with unresolved construction/semantic detail without forcing premature geometry.

final_rule: When translating incomplete AEC evidence into a neutral model, preserve what is known, distinguish how it is known, keep unknowns null, and assign reconstruction/buildability independently from evidence confidence. Do not choose a host-software representation until the neutral specification is sufficiently resolved.
validation: Every constructed coordinate or dimension must trace to dimensioned or explicitly valid derived evidence.
Observed and proportional evidence must not silently become exact geometry.
Fields listed as unknown remain null after neutral reconstruction.
Sketch axes must not acquire compass meaning without evidence.
Shared boundaries must be represented topologically even when their solidity or opening state is unresolved.
A downstream mapper must preserve identifiers, evidence kinds, nulls, relationships and validation checks.
Target-specific creation is a later mapping step, not part of the neutral evidence model.

failure_patterns_proposed.name: Semantic collapse to geometry-only output
failure_patterns_proposed.example: Treating 'wall' as an STL box instead of a semantic/relational building object or neutral specification.

failure_patterns_proposed.name: Confidence promotes guess to geometry
failure_patterns_proposed.example: A visually plausible partition dimension becomes an exact coordinate even though it was never dimensioned.

failure_patterns_proposed.name: Host-software assumptions leak upstream
failure_patterns_proposed.example: Choosing Revit wall families, levels or north/east axes before the neutral source frame justifies them.

failure_patterns_proposed.name: Completeness pressure destroys uncertainty
failure_patterns_proposed.example: Inventing window sizes, roof pitch or wall thickness because a target model expects them.

usage_report.tool_calls_and_retries: Not recorded precisely for the initial experiment.
usage_report.result: candidate lesson; neutral Building 001 v0.2 created and independently reviewed
qaqc_feedback: v0.1 proportional partition coordinates rejected as binding
v0.2 evidence classification accepted as stronger basis
independent build_state axis identified as next refinement

curation_notes: This contribution proposes a new upstream neutral-definition class and may require vocabulary/schema changes before it can become a canonical pack.
The existing ARPL name and Revit-focused library do not need to be renamed for this pilot; the neutral workflow can be introduced experimentally.
Building 001 is intended as the first reproducible case for testing whether another AI can reconstruct the same building without access to the source sketch.
